design_sources.title: The role of visual complexity and prototypicality regarding first impression of websites
design_sources.use: Control visual complexity while preserving recognizable website structure.

design_sources.title: Humans Prefer Curved Visual Objects
design_sources.use: Use curvature deliberately for welcome, care, and consultation contexts; do not treat it as a universal conversion law.

design_sources.title: Processing Fluency and Aesthetic Pleasure
design_sources.use: Use hierarchy, contrast, symmetry, repetition, and familiar patterns to make expressive composition easier to process.

design_sources.title: The Effects of Line Length on Reading Performance of Online News Articles
design_sources.use: Treat reading measure as a tested variable instead of repeating a universal typography myth.

design_sources.title: Placement of Call to Action Buttons for Higher Website Conversion and Acquisition
design_sources.use: Place the primary next action in a predictable scan path and repeat it after decision-supporting content.

design_sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Target Size Minimum
design_sources.use: Keep mobile targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or provide sufficient spacing; important actions exceed the minimum.

design_sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Animation from Interactions
design_sources.use: Disable nonessential interaction motion when the user requests reduced motion.

design_sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide
design_sources.use: Do not let auto-moving content become required reading or an unpausable distraction.

kimi_source.use: Clean-room extraction of reusable patterns only; no copied implementation or visual-parity claim.
